mapper.update: UPDATE gold_jobs SET duration = ( SELECT COALESCE(CAST(MAX(completion_time) - MIN(submission_time) AS BIGINT), 0) FROM gold_stages s WHERE s.app_id = gold_jobs.app_id AND list_contains(string_split(gold_jobs.stage_ids, ','), CAST(s.stage_id AS VARCHAR)) ), num_tasks = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.num_tasks), 0) FROM gold_stages s WHERE s.app_id = gold_jobs.app_id AND list_contains(string_split(gold_jobs.stage_ids, ','), CAST(s.stage_id AS VARCHAR)) ), num_completed_stages = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_stages s WHERE s.app_id = gold_jobs.app_id AND s.completion_time IS NOT NULL AND list_contains(string_split(gold_jobs.stage_ids, ','), CAST(s.stage_id AS VARCHAR)) ), num_completed_tasks = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_tasks t WHERE t.app_id = gold_jobs.app_id AND t.status = 'SUCCESS' AND list_contains(string_split(gold_jobs.stage_ids, ','), CAST(t.stage_id AS VARCHAR)) ), num_failed_tasks = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gold_tasks t WHERE t.app_id = gold_jobs.app_id AND t.status = 'FAILED' AND list_contains(string_split(gold_jobs.stage_ids, ','), CAST(t.stage_id AS VARCHAR)) ), performance_score = ( SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(s.duration) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(s.performance_score * s.duration) / SUM(s.duration) AS DOUBLE) ELSE CAST(COALESCE(AVG(s.performance_score), 0) AS DOUBLE) END FROM gold_stages s WHERE s.app_id = gold_jobs.app_id AND list_contains(string_split(gold_jobs.stage_ids, ','), CAST(s.stage_id AS VARCHAR)) ) WHERE app_id = #{appId}
